channel.title: Understanding Coffee Cultivation :: Commodity Recognition Book
channel.description: Learn how coffee is grown and why it looks the way it does from above.

item.title: Coffee Cultivation Systems
item.description: Examples demonstrating the diversity of coffee production systems.

item.title: The Coffee Life Cycle
item.description: Explore the relationship between the age of a coffee plantation and its appearance in satellite imagery.

item.title: Shade Management
item.description: The level of shade in coffee systems significantly influences how they appear in high-resolution imagery.

item.title: Intercropping Practices
item.description: In many coffee systems, intercropping is used to enhance income or improve soil management; these practices result in denser canopy structures and often obscure soil visibility in high-resolution imagery.

item.title: Pruning Practices
item.description: Pruning affects the height, density, and overall structure of coffee trees, impacting the way they appear in satellite imagery.

item.title: Coffee Varieties
item.description: The appearance of coffee systems in imagery can vary significantly due to regional differences in coffee varieties and their associated growing conditions.

item.title: Irrigation Practices
item.description: Irrigation is a key feature of highly intensified coffee systems, particularly in regions like Vietnam. Plots with irrigation systems often exhibit uniform growth and phenology, resulting in distinct patterns visible in high-resolution imagery.

item.title: Seasonal Cycles
item.description: Robusta coffee goes through a growth cycle of two years, throughout which its appearance varies in satellite imagery.
